== Notes ==
* The holy damage is applied only to adjacent foes (not to the target).
* This skill is extremely effective with [[Fragility]] and skills that inflict conditions (such as [[Apply Poison]] or [[Sneak Attack]]).
{{bug|The holy damage is dealt to other foes adjacent to yourself, not adjacent to the target.}}
